battle.name: 哈札爾汗國解體
battle.theater: 伏爾加河下游伊蒂爾城與薩爾凱爾
battle.brief: 公元965年，基輔大公斯維亞托斯拉夫東征，攻破哈札爾人控制頓河的薩爾凱爾堡，並於968至969年洗劫伏爾加河畔的都城伊蒂爾，汗國從此瓦解。卡面羅馬重步兵不在九世紀草原上，只作制度對照：汗國與拜占庭同樣靠常備重裝部隊與關稅立國，只是十世紀重裝兵已由羅馬盾牆步兵換成拜占庭甲騎。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 公元965年崩解的哈札爾汗國是本場衝突的主角。它名義上由可汗統率、卡巴爾（部族首長會議）分掌民政，首都伊蒂爾橫跨伏爾加河下游兩岸：西岸的哈拉桑是哈札爾貴族的居所，帶著約四千名侍從；東岸的伊蒂爾本城聚居著猶太人、基督徒、穆斯林、奴隸、手藝匠與外來商人。汗國巔峰時以中央財政體制維持一萬至一萬二千人的常備軍，必要時再從貴族私兵的後備中擴充兩三倍，軍隊由可汗與白克統率，下設土爾漢一級的指揮官。與之對手的，是基輔羅斯大公斯維亞托斯拉夫一世率領的羅斯聯盟：骨幹是結社與薩爾梅爾徵召兵，並有楚德等北部部族與諾夫哥羅德的兵眾同行。真正把三方綁在一起的，是拜占庭帝國：皇帝君士坦丁七世既是哈札爾人的盟友與庇護者，也在965年把哈札爾可汗接入君士坦丁堡，同時向草原上的突厥（匈牙利人）發出召集令，用佩切涅格人與馬茲爾人制衡羅斯人。汗國的附庸與邊境堡壘——薩爾凱爾（貝拉亞維扎）、圖穆塔拉坎、班加爾、塞梅德爾——在同一段時間裡被羅斯人的環形掃蕩逐一拔除；而東面的伏爾加保加爾已在921至922年改宗伊斯蘭，割斷了汗國的信仰共同體。
countriesEn: The Khazar Khaganate, whose disintegration this campaign records, was a semi-nomadic Turkic confederation ruled by a qaghan in nominal partnership with the qabaly, the council of tribal chiefs. Its capital, Atil, straddled the two banks of the lower Volga: on the western bank lay Kharazān, the residence of the Khazar elite with a retinue of some four thousand attendants, while Atil proper on the eastern bank housed Jews, Christians, Muslims, slaves, craftsmen and foreign merchants. At its height the state ran a centralised fiscal system supporting a standing army of seven to twelve thousand men, expandable to two or three times that number by calling in the reserves of noble retinues; the army was led by the qaghan and the beg, with subordinate commanders of the rank of tarkhan. The opposite party was the Rus' alliance led by Grand Prince Sviatoslav I of Kiev, whose backbone was the druzhina and the smerdy levy, joined by northern tribes such as the Chudes and troops from Novgorod. Binding all three parties together was the Byzantine Empire. Emperor Constantine VII was both the Khazars' ally and their protector: in 965 he received the Khazar khan in Constantinople, and at the same time issued a summons to the 'Turks' of the steppe, the Hungarians, and used the Pechenegs and the Magyars to hold the Rus' in balance. The Khazar dependencies and frontier strongholds — Sarkel (Belaya Vezha), Tmutarakan, Balanjar and Semender — were picked off one by one in the same stretch of months by the Rus' sweep that went round the khanate, while on its eastern side the Volga Bulgars, converted to Islam in 921–922, had already severed the religious bond that had held the state together.
people: 本役的關鍵人物大半沒能留下姓名，這本身就是汗國解體的寫照。羅斯一方的主帥是基輔大公斯維亞托斯拉夫一世，伊戈爾之子，約942年生，972年被佩切涅格人殺死。他自幼在基輔的宮廷中長大，父王伊戈爾被佩切涅格首領殺害、母親奧莉格被迫改嫁的記憶，使他很早便熟悉草原的規則：想走東道，就得付通行錢，或者付性命。950年代他把都城從基輔遷到第聶伯河畔的科爾特梅利克，把國家的人馬與河道擺成一副準備東進的樣子。哈札爾一方，可汗的名字在拜占庭與阿拉伯史料中都已失傳，只知他以可汗與白克的身份退守伊蒂爾，城破之後渡海投奔君士坦丁七世，得到庇護與俸祿；真正決定戰局走向的是一群沒有名字的人：伊蒂爾的守軍指揮官與屯長（土爾漢），以及在可汗與白克之間爭權的卡巴爾。拜占庭方面，留下記錄的是宮廷史家利奧·格拉瑪提科斯，他在965年條目中寫下羅斯人攻擊哈札爾、可汗出逃、皇帝收留，以及皇帝與烏古爾人部隊在邊境相遇而各自收兵。同一批史料裡還有別的關鍵角色：哈札爾使者哈巴爾，早年曾在君士坦丁堡被皇帝追問羅斯人的虛實；阿拉伯方面的伊本·法德蘭，921至922年出使伏爾加保加爾並記下哈札爾人作為國家骨幹的信仰狀況；伊本·魯斯塔記錄了哈札爾的軍制與兵力；伊本·阿西爾則在965年記下哈札爾向花剌子模求援遭拒、可汗改宗伊斯蘭一事。匈牙利人一側，雙重統治的君德與久拉尚未渡過多瑙河，正帶著部眾在黑海北岸游弋。
peopleEn: Most of the decisive figures of this campaign left no name behind, which is itself the story of the khanate's collapse. On the Rus' side the commander was Grand Prince Sviatoslav I of Kiev, son of Igor, born about 942 and killed by the Pechenegs in 972. He grew up in the court of Kiev, and the memory of his father Igor's murder by a Pecheneg prince and of his mother Olga's forced remarriage taught him early the rules of the steppe: to travel the eastern road one either paid the toll in money or paid in blood. In the 950s he moved his capital from Kiev to Chortomlyk on the Dnieper, arranging men and river so that the state looked ready to march east. On the Khazar side the name of the khan is lost in both Byzantine and Arabic sources; all that is known is that he withdrew to Atil in the person of the qaghan and beg, and after the city fell crossed the sea to the protection of Constantine VII, receiving a pension and a refuge there. What actually decided the battle was a body of people whose names were never written down: the commanders and tarkhans of the garrison at Atil, and the qabaly who fought the khan and beg for control. On the Byzantine side the record was left by the court historian Leo the Grammarian, whose entry for 965 sets down the Rus' attack on the Khazars, the flight of the khan, his reception by the emperor, and the meeting on the frontier where the emperor's forces and the Ugrian troops parted and withdrew. The same body of material holds other names that matter: Chabar, the Khazar envoy who was questioned at Constantinople about the true state of the Rus'; Ibn Fadlan, who travelled to the Volga Bulgars in 921–922 and reported on the faith of the Khazars who formed the state's core; Ibn Rustah, who recorded the Khazar military system and numbers; and Ibn al-Athir, who in 965 noted the Khazar appeal to Khwarazm, its refusal, and the conversion of the khan to Islam. On the Hungarian side the dual rulers, the kende-kündü and the gyula, had not yet crossed the Danube and were still moving their people along the northern shore of the Black Sea.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬重步兵是國家出錢養出的職業重步兵：分段鎧甲配重盾，靠操典、盾牆、投射兵器與嚴格的行軍秩序維持戰力，而不是靠裝甲本身。965年的草原上沒有這種兵種，它在這場戰爭裡的位置只能從兩條線索去找。第一條線索在拜占庭：君士坦丁七世麾下的甲騎披札甲、配長矛、抵肩衝鋒，直接承襲晚期羅馬的甲馬兵制度，與卡面同屬國家養專業重裝部隊的傳統，只是把步兵換成了騎兵。第二條線索在哈札爾與羅斯：汗國的常備軍一萬至一萬二千人，由土爾漢以下的指揮官率領，裝備是草原式的——複合反曲弓、直刃薩布爾、長矛與標槍，貴族與骨幹穿札甲或鎖子甲，馬具用高鞍橋，10世紀末到11世紀的草原墓葬已見馬鐙。真正上陣的是另一套東西：《管治篇》第四十章（一般認為出自約翰·斯基利茲之手）描述羅斯人用狹長平底船與多人划槳的艦隊，船手戴盔持盾而通常不着甲，使用斧、矛與刀；攻城靠木塔、撞槌與火攻，把伊蒂爾城郊的葡萄園與灌溉綠帶一併燒掉，使守軍無法從城外援軍。哈札爾方面的裝備體系則是一整套稅賦制度：向二十五至三十個部族按戶征收貂皮、灰鼠皮、刀與迪拉姆，靠這筆收入養住軍隊與堡壘，薩爾凱爾要塞的牆以土坯砌在石基之上，箭樓密集。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman legionary, a professional heavy infantryman paid for by the state: segmented armour and a heavy shield, sustained not by the armour itself but by drill, the shield wall, missile weapons and strict marching order. No such troops existed on the steppe in 965, so the weapon's place in this war can only be traced along two lines. The first runs through Byzantium: the kataphraktoi under Constantine VII, armoured in lamellar and mail, carrying the long kontos and charging couched, directly continued the late Roman cataphract institution, and belonged to the same tradition of the state paying for professional heavy troops, only the infantry had been exchanged for cavalry. The second line runs through the Khazars and the Rus': the khanate's standing army of seven to twelve thousand men, led by commanders of the rank of tarkhan, was equipped in the steppe manner — composite reflex bows, straight sabres, lances and javelins, with the nobility and the core wearing lamellar or mail, and tall-saddle tack that by the late tenth and eleventh centuries leaves archaeological traces in the form of stirrups. What actually went into the field was something else again: chapter forty of the De Administrando Imperio, generally ascribed to John Skylitzes, describes the Rus' using long narrow flat-bottomed boats rowed by many oars, their crews wearing helmets and carrying shields but normally no body armour, and fighting with axes, spears and knives. Siege work was done with wooden towers, rams and fire, burning the vineyards and the irrigated belt outside Atil so that the defenders could be reinforced from outside the walls. On the Khazar side the equipment system was in fact a whole system of taxation: sable skins, squirrel pelts, knives and dirhams levied per household from twenty-five to thirty tribes, and the revenue of that system paid for the army and the strongholds, Sarkel's walls being mud brick on a stone base with closely spaced towers.
tactics: 羅斯人這場東征是一整套河運加騎兵的戰術，而不是正面會戰。斯維亞托斯拉夫先把艦隊沿第聶伯河與其支流推上東行線，靠陸路拖運與轉運把船隻和兵員一批批送往東面，再順伏爾加河下行，抵達哈札爾首都伊蒂爾；軍隊沒有沿整條防線拉開，而是對薩爾凱爾、圖穆塔拉坎等外圍堡壘逐一包圍，切斷各堡之間的聯繫，迫使守軍分兵，這正是後世稱為環形掃蕩的打法。攻城時，羅斯人以艦隊封住河面，用木塔貼近城牆，撞槌破門，並燒掉城郊的葡萄園與灌溉渠，令守軍斷了外援。哈札爾一方的戰術完全建立在騎兵與稅關上：平時靠白克與土爾漢率輕騎在羅斯人行軍縱隊兩側以箭雨襲擾，迫其結陣滯行，消耗其馬力與士氣；一旦被圍，則退守堡壘等待援軍。問題在於可汗與白克、卡巴爾之間的分裂：命令下不來，各堡守軍各自為戰，士氣一垮便無法再戰。拜占庭這邊的戰術最簡單也最有效：不與羅斯人爭奪內陸，而是把艦隊與烏古爾人部隊調到邊境，用佩切涅格人與匈牙利人作前沿屏障，等羅斯人逼近再攔截、議和，同時用外交把哈札爾人牢牢留在自己這一邊。
tacticsEn: The Rus' eastern expedition of 965 was a whole technique of river movement combined with cavalry, not a set-piece battle. Sviatoslav first pushed his flotillas up the Dnieper and its tributaries onto the eastward line, using portages and transshipment on land to move boats and men forward in batches, and then went down the Volga to the Khazar capital at Atil. Instead of stretching his force along the whole line he surrounded the outer strongholds one by one — Sarkel, Tmutarakan and the rest — cutting the forts off from each other and forcing the defenders to divide, which is why later writers call the campaign a circular sweep. In the assault the fleet sealed the river, wooden towers were brought up against the walls, rams broke the gates, and the vineyards and irrigation ditches outside the town were burned to cut the defenders off from relief. The Khazar side fought entirely with cavalry and with the customs posts: normally the beg and the tarkhans rode light horse along both flanks of the marching column, showering it with arrows to force it to form up and slow down, and wearing out its horses and its nerve; once surrounded, the garrisons simply fell back into the forts and waited for relief. The problem was the fracture between the khan, the beg and the qabaly: orders did not travel, each fort fought its own battle, and once morale broke the line could not be restored. Byzantine tactics were the simplest and the most effective of the three: rather than contesting the interior, the emperor moved the fleet and the Ugrian troops to the frontier, used the Pechenegs and the Hungarians as a forward screen, let the Rus' come up and then intercepted them and made terms, while diplomacy kept the Khazars firmly on the imperial side.
data: 可核的數字不多，但足以描出規模。哈札爾巔峰期的常備軍估計為一萬至一萬二千人，必要時可從貴族私兵後備中擴充兩三倍；另有說法把常備軍推到十萬。稅源是二十五至三十個部族的進貢，按戶或按犁繳納一張貂皮、一件灰鼠皮、一把刀或一枚迪拉姆，地區不同也可交皮革、蠟、蜂蜜與牲畜。首都伊蒂爾分兩岸：西岸哈拉桑住著可汗與哈札爾貴族，侍從約四千人；東岸本城住著猶太人、基督徒、穆斯林、奴隸與工匠。城外從伏爾加河引水灌溉的綠帶與葡萄園延伸約二十波斯里（約六十英里）。商貿糾紛由七人法庭裁決，猶太、穆斯林、基督徒各兩人，異教徒一人；北方商隊的船隊在伊蒂爾繳納什一稅。阿拉伯地理學家伊本·魯斯塔記載哈札爾軍為一萬騎兵、四萬步兵，各抄本數字有出入。羅斯方面，965年出征的兵員在現有史料中沒有留下數目；可作對照的是六年後斯維亞托斯拉夫與拜占庭議和時自報的六千人。行程方面，從第聶伯河上游到伏爾加河下游再折回基輔，步行與騎兵混合的隊伍要走一千五百公里以上。年份序列清楚：913年羅斯人遭擊後汗國封閉伏爾加通道，960年代初可汗約瑟夫致書哈薩德·伊本·沙布魯特說明封鎖，965年薩爾凱爾失守，968至969年伊蒂爾陷落，971年羅斯與拜占庭議和，972年斯維亞托斯拉夫陣亡，1048年伊本·白圖尼筆下伊蒂爾已是廢墟。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers are few, but enough to give the scale. The Khazar standing army at its height is estimated at seven to twelve thousand men, expandable to two or three times that by calling up the reserves of noble retinues; other estimates push the permanent army as high as a hundred thousand. The revenue came from the tribute of twenty-five to thirty tribes, assessed per household or per ploughshare at one sable skin, one squirrel pelt, a knife or a dirham, with hides, wax, honey and livestock accepted in other districts. The capital Atil was split across two banks: on the western bank Kharazān held the khan and the Khazar nobility with a retinue of about four thousand; on the eastern bank Atil proper housed Jews, Christians, Muslims, slaves and craftsmen. Outside the town an irrigated belt drawing water from the Volga, with meadows and vineyards, ran for about twenty farsakhs, roughly sixty miles. Trade disputes were settled by a court of seven judges, two each for the Jews, Muslims and Christians and one for the pagans, and northern merchant fleets passing Atil paid a tithe. The Arab geographer Ibn Rustah gives the Khazar army as ten thousand cavalry and forty thousand foot, though the numbers vary between manuscripts. On the Rus' side the size of the army that marched in 965 is nowhere recorded; for comparison, six years later Sviatoslav claimed six thousand men when he was negotiating with Byzantium. As for distance, a column mixing foot and horse marching from the upper Dnieper to the lower Volga and back to Kiev had to cover more than fifteen hundred kilometres. The sequence of years is clear: in 913, after the Rus' were beaten, the khanate closed the Volga passage; in the early 960s the khan Joseph wrote to Hasdai ibn Shaprut to explain the blockade; Sarkel fell in 965; Atil fell between 968 and 969; the Rus' made peace with Byzantium in 971; Sviatoslav was killed in 972; and by 1048 Al-Biruni could write that Atil already lay in ruins.
cause: 打起來的原因可以分成遠因與近因。遠因是汗國本身的結構性失衡：可汗與白克的權力受制於卡巴爾的部族首長，白克一旦兵敗，退路是處死殘兵而不是收縮，這種不留俘虜、不許退卻的紀律維持了半遊牧國的向心力，卻也讓每一次內部衝突都變成無法調和的裂痕；九世紀末到十世紀初，宗教上的分層又被一次大規模改宗拉得更開，伊本·阿西爾在965年就記下除可汗之外哈札爾人集體改宗伊斯蘭的說法。近因是河道關閉與商路爭奪。哈札爾人早期允許羅斯人使用伏爾加水道南下掠奪，阿爾·馬士迪記載可汗的條件是羅斯人分一半戰利品；913年拜占庭與羅斯議和後，瓦良格人闖入阿拉伯土地造成事端，哈札爾人協助或默許其事，花剌子模的伊斯蘭衛兵要求報復，羅斯遠征部隊被擊潰，汗國隨即封閉伏爾加通道，衝突就此埋下伏筆。960年代初可汗約瑟夫寫給哈薩德·伊本·沙布魯特的信，仍在強調自己守住河口，阻止羅斯人從海上與陸上動手。對斯維亞托斯拉夫而言，向東打通一條不經保加爾人與佩切涅格人的直達水道，比在基輔向拜占庭人低頭更有利；對哈札爾而言，閉關不納是唯一的手段，因為那條河的稅就是他們的國庫。同一時段，東方烏古斯人的侵逼與匈牙利人、佩切涅格人帶著整個部眾西遷，把草原縱深壓縮成一條狹窄的通道。
causeEn: The reasons for the fighting divide into distant and immediate causes. The distant cause is the structural imbalance of the khanate itself: the authority of the khan and the beg was held in check by the tribal chiefs of the qabaly, and when the beg's army was beaten the only accepted course was to execute the survivors rather than to retreat, and this discipline that left no prisoners alive and permitted no withdrawal held a semi-nomadic state together while ensuring that every internal conflict became an irreconcilable rupture. From the late ninth to the tenth century the religious stratification of the state was pulled further apart by a mass conversion: Ibn al-Athir records for 965 that, the khan apart, the Khazars converted to Islam in order to obtain an alliance. The immediate cause is the closure of the river and the struggle over the trade road. The Khazars had at first allowed the Rus' to use the Volga waterway to raid southward, and Al-Mas'udi records the khagan's condition that the Rus' give him half the booty. In 913, two years after Byzantium had concluded a peace with the Rus', a Varangian foray into Arab lands caused trouble with the Khazars' connivance, the Khwarazmian Islamic guard asked leave to retaliate, and the Rus' expedition was routed; the khanate then shut the Volga passage to the Rus', and the quarrel was left lying in the ground. In the early 960s the khan Joseph was still writing to Hasdai ibn Shaprut to stress that he guarded the mouth of the river and kept the Rus' from setting out by sea and by land. For Sviatoslav, opening a direct waterway eastward that bypassed the Bulgars and the Pechenegs was worth more than bowing to the Byzantines at Kiev; for the Khazars, closing the gate was the only instrument left, because the tax on that river was the treasury. At the same time the pressure of the Oghuz from the east and the westward migration of the Hungarians and Pechenegs with their whole peoples compressed the depth of the steppe into a narrow corridor.
impact: 這場崩解的直接後果，是草原上少了一個能收關稅、能派屯長、能築堡壘的緩衝國。伊蒂爾在968至969年被攻破之後，城市的葡萄園與灌溉綠帶被毀，渠道淤塞；伊本·哈卡爾與穆卡達西在其後仍提到這座城，但到1048年伊本·白圖尼筆下它已是廢墟。汗國的稅源與奴隸買賣管道轉到羅斯人與保加爾人手中，羅斯人把黑海北岸的部落變成可徵收的對象，並很快學會了草原的裝備與兵制；拜占庭失去了對付羅斯人的草原盟友，轉而倚重佩切涅格人與匈牙利人，於是巴爾幹邊界在接下來半個世紀裡不斷被試探。更深遠的影響在制度層面：基輔大公繼承的階梯式排序，普遍被認為取自哈札爾人的做法；拜占庭宮廷的騎裝出自哈札爾貴族；西遷的匈牙利人中混有被稱為卡巴爾的哈札爾異見部眾，他們融入匈牙利王國，拜占庭史家因此把匈牙利稱為西突厥，而把哈札爾稱為東突厥。波斯祆教的《Denkart》把哈札爾的衰落歸因於虛假的宗教，是當時外部觀察者的判詞；五個半世紀之後，乞卜剌等西部突厥西推，烏古斯西壓，佩切涅格人再被推去多瑙河，才真正填上這個真空。羅斯編年史把消滅哈札爾傳統的時間點與弗拉基米爾決定信仰相聯繫，986年的信仰辯論中有哈札爾的猶太人出席，而988年的受洗則是羅斯與阿拉伯方面（保加爾使節在985年後抵達基輔）議和的前提。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of this collapse was the loss, from the steppe, of a buffer state that could collect customs duties, send out tarkhans and build fortresses. After Atil was taken in 968–969 the vineyards and the irrigated belt around the city were destroyed and the channels silted up; Ibn Hawqal and al-Muqaddasi still mention the town afterwards, but by 1048 Al-Biruni could write that it was already in ruins. The khanate's tax income and its pipeline of the slave trade passed to the Rus' and to the Bulgars; the Rus' turned the tribes of the northern Black Sea coast into subjects who could be taxed, and soon took over steppe equipment and steppe tactics as well. Byzantium lost its steppe ally against the Rus' and turned instead to the Pechenegs and the Hungarians, which left the Balkan frontier probed again and again for the next half century. The deeper effects were institutional: the ladder system of succession in the princely retinue of Kiev is widely taken to have been modelled on Khazar practice; the riding habit worn at the Byzantine court came from the Khazar nobility; and among the Hungarians who migrated west there was a dissident Khazar body known as the Qabars, who were absorbed into the Hungarian kingdom, so that Byzantine writers came to call Hungary the Western Tourkia and Khazaria the Eastern Tourkia. The Zoroastrian Denkart attributed the Khazar decline to false religion, which is the verdict of an outside observer of the time; it took another five and a half centuries, with the western Turks pressing west, the Oghuz pressing east and the Pechenegs pushed to the Danube, to fill the vacuum properly. The Russian chronicles tie the end of Khazar tradition to Vladimir's choice of faith: Jews from Khazaria attended the disputation of 986, and the baptism of 988 was the precondition for the Rus' to make terms with the Arabs, whose Bulgar envoys reached Kiev after 985.
result: 結果可以分成三層。第一層是戰役本身：965年羅斯人攻破薩爾凱爾這座控制頓河下游的哈札爾要塞，隨後在968至969年之間拿下伊蒂爾，逐個拔除圖穆塔拉坎與高加索一線的哈札爾據點；可汗帶著部眾退入拜占庭的庇護之下，汗位的象徵由帝國的宮廷保存下來，汗國的實體則在草原上瓦解。也有學者指出，拜占庭編年史965年條目裡的哈札爾可汗可能是指同一地區的突厥部族首領，羅斯人那一年真正打的是東邊的欽察與草原聯盟；不管採取哪一種讀法，結果相同——哈札爾不再是可汗能號令的國家。第二層是區域格局：卡巴爾、佩切涅格人、欽察人與羅斯人瓜分了原汗國的牧地與稅路，羅斯人守住了第聶伯河到頓河、伏爾加河的水道，把草原的關稅與奴隸貿易握在自己手裡；伏爾加保加爾與後來的金帳汗國填補了裡海東岸的空白，拜占庭則失去了東方屏障，只能靠多瑙河上的外族盟軍與外交周旋。第三層是名號的消失：從十一世紀起，拜占庭文獻不再對草原政權使用可汗的稱號，殘餘的哈札爾首領在11世紀二三十年代被消滅於佩切涅格人與欽察人的進攻，貝拉亞維扎最後易手之時，草原上的汗國已經只剩地名與部族名。
resultEn: The result can be read on three levels. The first is the campaign itself: in 965 the Rus' broke Sarkel, the Khazar fortress commanding the lower Don, and between 968 and 969 they took Atil, pulling out the Khazar strongholds at Tmutarakan and along the Caucasian line one after another; the khan withdrew with his people under the protection of Byzantium, the symbol of the khanship was preserved in the imperial court, and the substance of the khanate dissolved on the steppe. Some scholars argue that the 'Khazar khan' in the Byzantine chronicle entry for 965 in fact denotes a Turkic tribal chief of the same region, and that what the Rus' really struck in that year was the Kipchak and steppe confederation further east; on either reading the result is the same — Khazaria was no longer a state that a khan could command. The second level is the regional pattern: the Qabars, the Pechenegs, the Kipchaks and the Rus' divided the pastures and the tax routes of the former khanate, the Rus' held the waterways from the Dnieper to the Don and the Volga and took the steppe's customs and slave trade into their own hands; the Volga Bulgars and later the Golden Horde filled the blank on the east side of the Caspian, while Byzantium, deprived of its eastern screen, had to rely on foreign allies on the Danube and on diplomatic manoeuvring. The third level is the disappearance of the name itself: from the eleventh century the Byzantine writers no longer used the title of khan for steppe rulers, the last Khazar chiefs were destroyed in the campaigns of the Pechenegs and Kipchaks in the twenties and thirties of the eleventh century, and by the time Belaya Vezha changed hands the khanate on the steppe had survived only as a place name and a tribal name.
